title: 第13章 赚麻了第14章 赌一波
slug: 重生本统子教宿主当老六
content_zh:
陆沉在乌泽城很有名，看着陆沉的表现，摊主也只当是他精神不正常，也没有过多怀疑。
“老板，这个多少钱？”
陆沉拿着盒子问道。
老板或许是同情陆沉，笑着说道：“一个不值钱的小物件，陆沉少爷要是喜欢拿去便是，不要钱。”
陆沉哪里肯白白占人家的便宜，果断拒绝：“那不行！
买东西要给钱的，老板你开个价。”
老板坚决地摆摆手：“陆少爷，我真不要钱，陆家一直以来对我们这些百姓多有照顾，这盒子就是个不起眼的小玩意儿，您直接拿去就好了。”
陆沉见状，实在过意不去，连忙拿去摊上的一个小巧花瓶：“那这个呢，你开个价，我两个一起拿了。”
“这个要一百灵石。”
老板开价道，看表情估计也是降了价的。
“好，成交！”
陆沉直接掏出一百灵石，放在老板面前：“老板你收好，我先走了，回见！”
老板收下灵石，恭恭敬敬地说道：“陆少爷，您慢走。”
陆沉继续走着，苟系统面露惊讶地说道：“苟宿主，这花瓶？”
陆沉一脸得意地说道：“我总不能白占人家的便宜，这花瓶虽然可能不值一百灵石，但那盒子咱们还是赚到了啊，这花瓶回去摆着也挺好看的。”
谁知苟系统捂着脸说道：“我不是那个意思，我是想问你怎么恰好就能选到那个花瓶的？”
说着又把一道信息甩在陆沉脸上：物品名称：有些年代的花瓶。
描述：一位炼药师的遗物，里面记载了一份二阶赤血散的丹方。
“二阶丹方！
？”

陆沉再度不淡定了。
要知道在这世界上炼药师可是非常珍稀的职业，丹方更是有价无市的存在，一份二阶丹方少说也值三千灵石。
9527心里止不住地吐槽道：“这苟宿主的运气还是一如既往的好啊！
这才花了一百灵石，就赚了五千。
回头我也要拜拜老天试试看。”
随即说道：“苟宿主，奖励拿好。”
说完，一个装着一枚绿色丹药的玉瓶出现在陆沉的储物袋里。
陆沉疑惑道：“你这么着急给我干嘛？在外面又不能吃。”
苟系统一脸坏笑着说道：“讲真的，我有个不太成熟的想法。”
陆沉见状流出一身冷汗，试探性地问道：“你想干嘛？”
苟系统没有说话，而是反手将一个任务甩在陆沉脸上：任务内容：今天累计捡漏收获达到一万灵石（价格由系统扫描判定）。
任务奖励：抽奖机会一次。
陆沉看了浑身充满干劲，果断接取了任务：“话说苟系统，咱俩这样算不算作弊啊？用你的扫描做你的任务，会不会不太好？”
苟系统撇了撇嘴说道：“你想多了，这玩意儿主要看运气，就比如那个花瓶。
没有运气的人拿着扫描也遇不到好东西。”
陆沉又接连逛了三个摊位，并没有什么收获，不过他也并不气馁，要是每一个摊位都有隐藏的宝物那才有鬼了。
终于，在第四个摊位前，9527再度眼前一亮，指着一小节枯木说道：“苟宿主，快快快，好东西！”
说着将信息甩了出来：物品名称：一小节龙涎木。
描述：蕴含庞大生命力的木材，研磨成粉可以用来炼制高阶丹药。
content_en:
Lu Chen was well-known in Wuze City. Seeing Lu Chen's performance, the stall owner just assumed that he was mentally disturbed and did not doubt him too much.
"Boss, how much does this cost?"
Lu Chen asked, holding the box.
Perhaps the boss sympathized with Lu Chen and said with a smile: "It's a worthless little object. If Master Lu Chen likes it, you can take it for free."
Lu Chen was not willing to take advantage of others in vain, so he decisively refused: "That won't work!
You have to pay to buy things. Boss, you set a price. "
The boss waved his hand resolutely: "Master Lu, I really don't want money. The Lu family has always taken good care of us common people. This box is just an inconspicuous gadget. You can just take it."
Lu Chen felt really sorry when he saw this, and quickly took out a small vase on the stall: "What about this one? You make a price, and I will take it together."
"This costs one hundred spirit stones."
The boss said the price, and judging by his expression, he probably lowered the price.
"Okay, deal!"
Lu Chen directly took out a hundred spirit stones and placed them in front of his boss: "Boss, please put them away. I'm leaving now. See you later!"
The boss accepted the spirit stone and said respectfully: "Master Lu, please go slowly."
Lu Chen continued walking, System Gou said with surprise: "Host Gou, this vase?"
Lu Chen said with a proud look on his face: "I can't take advantage of others in vain. Although this vase may not be worth a hundred spiritual stones, we still made money from the box. This vase will look good when we put it back."
Unexpectedly, Gou System covered his face and said, "That's not what I meant. I just wanted to ask you how you were able to choose that vase just right?"
Then he threw another piece of information on Lu Chen's face: Item name: Vase from a certain era.
Description: A relic of an alchemist, which contains a recipe for second-level red blood powder.
“Second-level elixir recipe!
? "
Lu Chen was not calm again.
You must know that an alchemist is a very rare profession in this world, and elixir prescriptions are priceless and marketless. A second-level elixir prescription is worth at least three thousand spiritual stones.
9527 couldn't stop complaining in his heart: "This host's luck is still as good as ever!
After only spending one hundred spirit stones, I made five thousand.
I will also say thank you to God and give it a try later. "
Then he said: "Host Gou, get your reward."
After speaking, a jade bottle containing a green elixir appeared in Lu Chen's storage bag.
Lu Chen asked doubtfully: "Why are you in such a hurry for me? You can't eat outside."
System Gou said with a smirk on his face: "To be honest, I have an immature idea."
Seeing this, Lu Chen broke out in cold sweat and asked tentatively, "What do you want to do?"
Gou System did not speak, but instead threw a task in Lu Chen's face: Task content: Today's cumulative harvest of lost spirit stones reached 10,000 spirit stones (the price is determined by the system scan).
Task reward: one chance to draw a lottery.
Lu Chen looked full of energy and accepted the task decisively: "Speaking of Gou System, does this count as cheating? Wouldn't it be bad to use your scan to complete your task?"
System Gou curled his lips and said, "You are overthinking it. This thing mainly depends on luck, just like that vase.
People who are unlucky will not encounter good things even if they scan. "
Lu Chen visited three more stalls in succession, but didn't gain much, but he was not discouraged. If every stall had hidden treasures, then there would be something wrong.
Finally, in front of the fourth stall, 9527's eyes lit up again, pointing to a small piece of dead wood and said: "Host Gou, hurry up, hurry up, good stuff!"
As he spoke, he threw out the information: Item name: A small section of ambergris.
Description: Wood containing huge vitality can be ground into powder and used to refine high-level elixirs.
